symptom: Internal SQL migration and security CI JavaScript are reachable by anonymous GET on the public production website.
cause: Netlify publishes repository root, including build-only artifacts not intended as public static assets; no private-source route denylist existed.

repair.production_verification: Require independent 404 GET and 200 homepage before GREEN.

prevention: Never publish repository source directories as website assets; use an allowlisted build directory as future architecture.
Fail closed if any database migration, CI script, private config or build manifest returns public HTTP 200.
Never silently revoke an intentionally token-gated anon database function; migrate it with independently verified caller and permissions.
